description: Reviewer-model settings shared by tools/review-plan.py and tools/review-execution.py. The reviewer must be a DIFFERENT model from your builder. To switch reviewers: change "active" below (muse | openai | claude), or override for one run with the REVIEWER_PROFILE env var or the scripts' --profile flag. No secrets live here: each profile's key comes from the environment variable named in api_key_env (or a KEY=VALUE line in ./.env). provider is 'openai' (OpenAI-compatible chat-completions) or 'anthropic' (Claude Messages API). Optional per-profile keys: temperature (null = do not send it), max_tokens_param (e.g. 'max_completion_tokens' for newer OpenAI models).
